hero.name: Colloquia
hero.tagline: Record a conversation on Android and get back who said what, a clean transcript, a summary and action items, then send them to Calendar, Tasks, Slack or Jira.
hero.label: Colloquia: record a conversation on Android and get a speaker-labelled transcript, a summary and action items, sent where the work happens

cards.label: What Colloquia does: record, keep offline, transcribe, analyse, ask and send

items.title: Record or import
items.body: Pause, resume and keep recording in the background, or import audio or video, cut to audio on the phone.

items.title: Nothing lost offline
items.body: A failed upload waits on the phone in an outbox and goes up when the library opens or you tap Upload now.

items.title: Speakers and languages
items.body: Deepgram nova-3 labels each speaker and follows code-switching; Whisper takes over when Deepgram fails.

items.title: One AI pass
items.body: gpt-4o-mini writes the title, clean dialogue, English copy, summary, actions and topics in one call.

items.title: Chat and search
items.body: Chat with one transcript, ask across all of them, and search by keyword, or by meaning with lite mode off.

items.title: Where work happens
items.body: Action items to Google Calendar and Tasks; notes to Slack, Teams, Notion, Trello, Jira or a webhook.

pipeline.label: How a recording travels: record, upload, queue, transcribe, analyse, act

stats.label: At a glance: two speech engines, three transcript modes, four summary types, four export formats

timeline.label: Colloquia so far: first build on 28 June, hardened on 29 June, multilingual on 2 July, provider keys rotatable at runtime since 12 July, live and voice screens still to build

footer.title: Every voice in the room, kept and put to work.
